description: Play mechanical keyboard sounds as you type, with customizable sound packs.
notes: Uses the official Windows NSIS installer as an archive and extracts its nested app-64.7z payload; the installer itself is not executed.

The upstream installer checks for and installs the Microsoft Visual C++ x64 Redistributable when missing. That step is skipped here; install the Visual C++ 2015–2022 Redistributable (x64) separately if required to launch the app.

Mechvibes stores settings and custom sound packs under Electron's user data directory, normally %APPDATA%\Mechvibes; these files are outside the Scoop app directory and are not moved to D: by this manifest.
The upstream README describes this repository as the legacy version while MechvibesDX is under active development: https://github.com/hainguyents13/mechvibes-dx.
